chat.message: I'm at Castro Theatre, near the box office. Where are you?
Coming from the coffee shop on Market, 2 min away. Walking fast.
I see you on the map, you're moving. I'm at the pin but there's construction, I'm parked 65m away on 18th St.
OK coming to 18th. My phone is about to die, if I go silent I'm almost there.
Still don't see you. Are you coming?
I've waited 7 minutes. Your GPS stopped updating at 7:06. I have to go, another pickup queued. Fee stands.
I was at 18th and Castro! I arrived right as you pulled away. My phone died so I couldn't message. You left one minute after I got there. I saw your taillights.

dispute.driver_statement: I arrived at the pin location at 7:04. Construction forced me to park on 18th Street, 65m away. The rider said she was coming from a coffee shop. Her GPS was approaching until 7:06 when it stopped updating — phone died. I waited until 7:11 (7 minutes). I had another pickup queued. The rider's GPS was approaching but it died before she arrived, so I couldn't confirm she was actually close. The 65m distance puts this in the grey zone, but I waited the full window.
dispute.rider_statement: I was walking toward the driver from the coffee shop. My GPS was updating and he could see me approaching. My phone died at 7:06 — I told him it was about to die. I arrived at 18th and Castro at 7:11 and saw him driving away. He was parked 65m from the pin because of construction. The 65m is his issue, not mine. I was there within the window. The fee is unjustified.

policies.rule_text: Where the driver did not come within 100 metres of the pickup pin, the no-show fee is refunded in full.
policies.title: Driver Non-Arrival

policies.rule_text: Where the driver came within 50 metres of the pickup pin, waited at least 5 minutes, and rider telemetry shows no movement toward the vehicle, the no-show fee stands.
policies.title: Driver Arrival - Fee Stands

policies.rule_text: Where the facts fall between the Policy 2.1a and 2.1b thresholds, the matter is not determinable on the record and is referred to human review.
policies.title: Grey-Band Referral

policies.rule_text: A rider who cancels within 2 minutes of acceptance without moving toward the pickup is not charged a no-show fee.
policies.title: Rider Cancellation Window
